purpose: Retain truthful bounded images from existing train forwards, including before a later failure, without changing learning or producing historical replacement images

capture.source: detached contiguous CPU FP32 copy of the existing generator prediction; no extra forward
capture.failureReference: only a previously captured frame with its original identity; no image when no prior capture
capture.modelBindingMeaning: model identity metadata, not a checkpoint or a snapshot of weights at this step

storage.unregisteredPartialWrite: not a valid viewable artifact; retain accurate error and original training first failure
storage.insufficientBudget: record preview unavailable without consuming failure reserves or retrying training

adoptionRequirements: New candidate binds actual producer, writer and query adapter source; preserve old consumed package and policy bytes
Verify trusted identities from existing plan/readers, do not trust syntactically valid SHA strings
Verify no tensor, RNG, model state, optimizer or gradient change by component observation
Verify normal, failure, budget and stale/mismatched artifact cases through existing interfaces
Inactive component metadata remains explicitly component-only until separately versioned production adoption; component-only tests cannot certify it
